areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: General objective directly tied to food insecurity and poverty; objectives, products, indicators and targets aligned; all actions relate to the aim and reach many beneficiaries, so impact potential is high.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No direct link to the general objective; significant resources go to infrastructure and social facilities, but these are not the project focus, so impact is low.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: A dedicated component targets work and income for vulnerable people, but its scope is limited because the project centers on social assistance policy; impact is low.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Aligned indicators exist, but few resources and limited scope, as digital upgrades cover only the proponent's social assistance agency; impact is barely relevant.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: Scope is strictly social and productive inclusion; digital actions are a tactical means, with no direct measures for digital transformation of the economy or alignment with the area.

not_accepted.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
not_accepted.reason: Scope is strictly social and productive inclusion; digital actions are a tactical means, with no direct measures for digital transformation of the economy or alignment with the area.

bonus.reason: All resources go to activities tied to the PPA priority of fighting hunger and reducing inequality, via social protection, food security and productive inclusion.
Proponent did not indicate regional integration; no points awarded.
